descriptionMarkdown:
Basically an upgrade of this thing I made.

https://factorioprints.com/view/-OwnSP-inmfzKyfJSeoh

Ready for the new plasma flow change in 2.1 and still works in 2.0.77.

The real limit is the pipe length, but you get 131GW of power at this point and using a few pump in between can make it endless provided you use enough pump.

You can easily upgrade all Fusion reactor/generator to higher quality for even more power.

For the cooling, it’s up to you really.

It takes a bit of time (a few minutes)  to get going and stabilize as per my test in the editor.

The basic design use 30% more reactor, but give 47% more power. So not much difference, but the real deal is with the bigger version.

The 4x one use 35% more reactor, but give 62.82% more power.

Flaws that are features: there will be inactive fusion generator because some are only used in the bigger version due to neighbour bonus. You can always delete the useless one.

Feel free to tinker and improve it, it’s clearly not the best, but it’s a simple design easy to paste.
title: [2.1] 5.3GW Modular Fusion power plant
